raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Programming & Core Concepts:
Java (8/11/17/21) – Streams, Lambdas, Functional Interfaces, Optionals, OOP, Exception Handling, Immutability, Multithreading (Executor Framework, Locks, Concurrency Utilities), Collections, Data Structures & Algorithms, Python, Go, Node.js, React, Angular
Cloud & DevOps:
AWS (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, Lambda, SQS/SNS, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, RDS, Glue, Step Functions), Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins, Git/GitHub, Bitbucket, Maven, SonarQube, CI/CD, Canary Deployments, Rollbacks
Frameworks & Libraries:
Spring Core, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud (Security, Data, MVC, AOP, JDBC, Reactive), Hibernate/JPA, Kafka (Producer/Consumer, Streams, Schema, Error Handling, Observability, CQRS, Materialized Views), RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, JMS, GraphQL (Apollo, Schema Federation, Resolvers, Caching), Open Telemetry, JUnit, Mockito, FIX Protocol, Creatomate API
Architecture & Patterns:
Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, REST APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger, Request/Response Handling, API Best Practices), SOAP Web Services, API Gateway (Zuul, Keycloak Integration), Service Discovery (Eureka), Circuit Breaker (Hystrix), CQRS, GoF Design Patterns (Creational, Structural, Behavioral), Cloud-Native & Distributed Systems
Databases & Caching:
MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redshift, RDBMS/NoSQL (Joins, Indexing, Data Modeling, Sharding, CDC), Redis, Hazelcast, Caffeine, Memcached
Observability & Performance:
ELK Stack, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Jaeger, Kiali, New Relic, JProfiler, JMeter, JVM Tuning, GC Configuration, Profiling, Dump Analysis
Security & Compliance:
OAuth 2.0, JWT, SAML, LDAP, API Security, PCI-DSS, ISO 8583, Digital Certificates & Signatures
Methodologies & Practices:
Agile (Scrum, Kanban), Waterfall, TDD, Mocking, Postman Testing, Security/Performance Test Automation, Pair Programming, Solution & Architecture Artifacts (Logical Views, Sequence Diagrams, Layering), Leadership & Mentorship
Additional Skills (Nice-to-Have):
GenAI, AEM, Sitecore, Production Support, Rollbacks, Canary Deployments
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Job responsibilities
Develop and maintain high-quality software applications using Java, Spring Boot, React, and other relevant technologies.
Integrate backend services with AWS cloud platforms including EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, and Lambda to ensure scalable and efficient application architecture.
Design, implement, and optimize database schemas using SQL and NoSQL databases like DynamoDB.
Build and deploy microservices-based architectures using Docker and Kubernetes on AWS EKS.
Contribute to the development of reusable components and libraries to improve code quality and reduce development time.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, and QA engineers to deliver high-quality software products.
Perform code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers to maintain high coding standards.
Resolve bugs and performance issues quickly and efficiently.
Participate in continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to automate testing and deployment processes.
Provide technical leadership to junior developers, sharing best practices and staying up-to-date with the latest trends and technologies.
Organization: Encora Digital Pvt. Ltd - Technical Lead – MAY-2023 – Till Date
Client : NewRelic				FEB 2025 – Till Date
Project Name – S3-to-Redshift Ingestion & Cost Optimization Platform
Role - Technical Lead
Description - Worked for the optimized the cost of AWS services and move the file from S3 to Redshift.
Responsibilities-
Led performance monitoring and cost optimization initiatives using New Relic and AWS CloudWatch, identifying underutilized resources and optimizing EC2, S3, and RDS usage to reduce cloud expenditure.
Automated data ingestion pipelines to move large files from S3 to Amazon Redshift, improving data availability for analytics and reporting.
Client Name - LG		   	     	     		   JUN 2024 - JAN 2025
Project Name - B2B E-commerce Platform
Role - Technical Lead
Description - Led the development and management of LG's B2B e-commerce platform. Key responsibilities included implementing product catalog features such as category-based product addition, enabling search functionality based on category and price filters, and managing discount configurations to support dynamic pricing strategies for bulk buyers.
Responsibilities-
Own solution architecture, technical design reviews and PoCs for a multi‑tenant e‑commerce & logistics platform handling 20M+ records/day.
Led a team of 8 developers; introduced GitHub Actions + SonarQube pipeline, reducing PR merge time by 35%.
Client Name - Beckett		   	     	     		   FEB 2024 - MAY 2024
Project Name - Card Grading & Shipping System
Role - Technical Lead
Description - Designed and implemented a modular card‑grading & shipping module (Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL) that cut manual processing by 40 %.
Responsibilities-
Architected and implemented microservices for grading and shipping workflows using Spring Boot.
Integrated Kafka for reliable asynchronous communication between grading, payment, and fulfilment modules.
Designed PostgreSQL schema to support flexible card metadata and audit tracking.
Developed secure RESTful APIs for internal tools and external client systems.
Worked closely with product and operations teams to refine workflows and reduce processing overhead.
Led code reviews, performance tuning, and ensured high service availability.
Client Name - Broadcom		   	     	     		   NOV 2023 – JAN 2024
Project Name - Certificate Ingestion & Visualization Platform
Role - Technical Lead
Description - Built a certificate ingestion service integrating with legacy systems and persisting artefacts across MySQL, S3 and MongoDB, enabling real‑time dashboard visualization.
Responsibilities-
Designed and developed ingestion pipelines to process certificate data from legacy systems.
Implemented secure data storage and retrieval mechanisms using MySQL, MongoDB, and AWS S3.
Exposed RESTful APIs for downstream analytics and dashboard services.
Ensured high availability, data consistency, and encryption of sensitive artifacts.
Collaborated with front-end and DevOps teams to support real-time dashboard integration and CI/CD workflows.
Tuned database queries and storage strategies to support high-volume certificate data with low latency.
Client Name - Nectar		   	     	     		   MAY 2023 – OCT 2023
Project Name - Institute & Faculty Management System
Role - Technical Lead
Description - Designed and developed a scalable system for managing educational institutes and faculty profiles, supporting role-based access, scheduling, and administrative workflows to streamline operations across multiple institutions.
Responsibilities-
Architected core modules for institute registration, faculty onboarding, and role-based access control.
Designed normalized PostgreSQL schema to support multi-institute data isolation and integrity.
Implemented RESTful APIs for integration with front-end portals and third-party services.
Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver customized workflows.
Ensured system scalability to support onboarding of multiple institutes and thousands of users.
Using creatomate API created the video from text and image.

Client Name - Symbo Insurance/ Tokio insurance		   
Project Name - Insurance Pricing Engine 
Role - Technical Lead
Description - Architected and delivered a high-performance insurance pricing engine capable of processing 1 million quotes per hour with <150ms latency, ensuring real-time responsiveness for quote generation across multiple insurance products.

Architected and delivered an insurance pricing engine processing 1 M quotes/hr with <150 MS latency (Java 17, Spring Boot, Redis, Open Telemetry).
Collaborated with actuaries to model complex premium calculations and exposed them via GraphQL APIs consumed by web & mobile clients.

Client Name - Mastercard				
Project Name - Foreign Exchange Integration Platform
Role - Senior Java Developer
Description - Developed and integrated a foreign exchange microservice that connected with seven core banking systems using FIX protocol and REST protocols. The solution improved straight-through processing (STP) by 28%, reducing manual intervention and operational delays.

Client Name - HDFC, Central Bank of India			
Project Name - Aadhaar-Enabled Payment System (AEPS)
Role - Senior Member of Technical Staff
Description - Delivered a robust Aadhaar-Enabled Payment System (AEPS) supporting deposit, withdrawal, balance enquiry, and e-KYC services. The platform ensured secure biometric-based transactions and achieved 99.98% uptime, serving millions of customers in rural and semi-urban regions.

Client Name - Syndicate Bank		   
Project Name – eKYC and AEPS
Role - Software Engineer
Description - Implemented ISO 8583 transaction flows and device SDK enhancements for biometric PoS terminals used by state‑run banks.
Responsibilities-
Designed and implemented secure transaction workflows integrating with UIDAI and NPCI systems.
Led requirements analysis and technical workshops with NPCI and partner banks to finalize AEPS specifications.
Ensured end-to-end PCI-DSS compliance, including data encryption, secure APIs, and access controls.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to enable real-time transaction processing and error handling.
Conducted integration testing and certification cycles with partner banks and biometric device vendors.
Organization: Nysa Communications — Java Developer—OCT 14 to JUN 16
Client Name - Guwahati University			   
Project Name - Payroll & Salary Management System
Role - Java Developer
Description - Built a payroll & salary engine (Spring MVC, MySQL) for SME clients, reducing monthly processing effort by 75 %.

Developed payroll logic including allowances, deductions, and tax slabs using Spring MVC and MySQL.
Created user interfaces and workflows for HR/admin staff to manage employee records and generate reports.
Implemented validation rules, audit trails, and role-based access for data integrity and security.
Automated payslip generation and integrated with email delivery for employee notifications.
Collaborated with finance and HR stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver a tailored solution.
